what: How much memory one process can allocate through the Honeykrisp Vulkan driver on Omarchy Linux, with HK_SYSMEM unset

vulkaninfoReadings.driver: Mesa 26.3.0-devel (git-6543eeb7df), separate private lab build selected with a driver-file override

vulkaninfoMethod: vulkaninfo memoryHeaps[0] size, run on each Mac after boot with the variable removed from the environment and no drirc override.
whyTheTwoBuilds: Mesa commit 5f3f7e4db52 (2026-10-09, "hk: default the device heap to 90% of system memory") changed the Honeykrisp default from 50% to 90%. Build 6543eeb7df is from 2026-10-07, build 69bde15340 from 2026-10-11.

mlxProbe13inch.method: allocate 1 GiB GPU blocks through MLX until failure, at most 15
mlxProbe13inch.reading: Both runs stop at the same 12 GiB. Twelve GiB is 79% of the 16 GB RAM, so the stock heap is not 50%; a 13.6 GiB heap that also holds other allocations is consistent with 12 blocks.
mlxProbe13inch.recordedBy: the lab MLX owner; output of the probe, run 2026-10-28 05:59 UTC

notMeasured: No reading exists yet for the Mac mini (Apple M6, 32 GB) or for MLX on the 16-inch and 14-inch Macs beyond their vulkaninfo heaps.
